Name: Dog Revamped Colors
Author: Ruudrra
Description:
This mod adds new Revamped colors for the Stardew Valley dog!

NOTE: THE ONLY COLORS AVAILABLE ARE THE DARK BROWN AND GOLDEN COLORS, MORE WILL BE ADDED VERY SOON!

Instructions:
1. Unzip the downloaded file.
2. Recommended: Backup your original dog from the Contents, Animal folder in your game files (To back it up, Copy and Paste the file into a different loacation).
3. Copy the dog.xnb file into the Contents, Animal folder and replace the original file.
4. Launch the game and enjoy your new dog!

Downloads.Description: Revamped Colors (Golden and Dark Brown) for the Stardew Valley Dog.
